Enable.Name: Enable Voice
Enable.Description: When off, prompts show text only without voice

VoicePack.Name: Voice Pack
VoicePack.Description: Audio pack in use (global, shared by all worlds). Auto = the installed pack with the highest priority

Interrupt.Name: Interrupt Playing Voice
Interrupt.Description: A new voice line immediately cuts off the one currently playing instead of overlapping

Volume.Name: Voice Volume
Volume.Description: Multiplier relative to the game sound volume

Cooldown.Name: Per-line Cooldown (s)
Cooldown.Description: Minimum interval before the same voice line can play again
